backup_disposition_time_check.name: backup_disposition_time_check
backup_disposition_time_check.value: julianday("backup_disposition"."due_at") IS NOT NULL AND (("backup_disposition"."status"='pending' AND "backup_disposition"."verified_at" IS NULL) OR ("backup_disposition"."status"='verified' AND julianday("backup_disposition"."verified_at") IS NOT NULL))

correction_request_close_check.name: correction_request_close_check
correction_request_close_check.value: ("correction_request"."status" IN ('closed','abandoned') AND "correction_request"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("correction_request"."status" IN ('draft','submitted','ask_changes') AND "correction_request"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "correction_request"."log_id" IS NOT NULL)

correction_request_hide_check.name: correction_request_hide_check
correction_request_hide_check.value: ("correction_request"."hidden_at" IS NULL AND "correction_request"."hidden_by" IS NULL AND "correction_request"."hide_reason" IS NULL AND "correction_request"."restored_at" IS NULL) OR ("correction_request"."hidden_at" IS NOT NULL AND "correction_request"."hidden_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("correction_request"."hide_reason")) > 0)

export_delivery_time_check.name: export_delivery_time_check
export_delivery_time_check.value: julianday("export_delivery"."created_at") IS NOT NULL AND julianday("export_delivery"."expires_at") IS NOT NULL AND "export_delivery"."created_at"<"export_delivery"."expires_at" AND julianday("export_delivery"."expires_at")<=julianday("export_delivery"."created_at")+1

export_delivery_writer_check.name: export_delivery_writer_check
export_delivery_writer_check.value: "export_delivery"."write_inflight" IN (0,1) AND ("export_delivery"."write_inflight"=0 OR "export_delivery"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "export_delivery"."purged_at" IS NULL AND "export_delivery"."downloaded_at" IS NULL)

log_revision_effective_check.name: log_revision_effective_check
log_revision_effective_check.value: "log_revision"."effective_on" IS NULL OR ("log_revision"."effective_on" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date("log_revision"."effective_on", '+0 days') IS "log_revision"."effective_on")

log_revision_outcome_check.name: log_revision_outcome_check
log_revision_outcome_check.value: ("log_revision"."rating" IN (1,2) AND "log_revision"."outcome" = 'negative') OR ("log_revision"."rating" = 3 AND "log_revision"."outcome" = 'mixed') OR ("log_revision"."rating" IN (4,5) AND "log_revision"."outcome" = 'positive')

maintenance_task_authorization_check.name: maintenance_task_authorization_check
maintenance_task_authorization_check.value: julianday("maintenance_task"."authorized_at") IS NOT NULL AND julianday("maintenance_task"."authorization_expires_at") IS NOT NULL AND julianday("maintenance_task"."due_at") IS NOT NULL AND "maintenance_task"."authorized_at"<"maintenance_task"."authorization_expires_at" AND (julianday("maintenance_task"."authorization_expires_at")-julianday("maintenance_task"."authorized_at"))*86400<=3600.001

moderation_case_state_check.name: moderation_case_state_check
moderation_case_state_check.value: ("moderation_case"."status" IN ('open','awaiting_changes') AND "moderation_case"."claimed_by" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."claimed_until" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decision" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."reason" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."closure_kind" IS NULL) OR ("moderation_case"."status" = 'claimed' AND "moderation_case"."claimed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_case"."claimed_until" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_case"."decision" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."reason" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."closure_kind" IS NULL) OR ("moderation_case"."status" = 'decided' AND "moderation_case"."claimed_by" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."claimed_until" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_case"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("moderation_case"."reason", char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||' ')) > 0 AND "moderation_case"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_case"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND (("moderation_case"."closed_at" = "moderation_case"."decided_at" AND "moderation_case"."closure_kind" = 'decision') OR ("moderation_case"."kind" = 'verification' AND "moderation_case"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."closure_kind" IS NULL))) OR ("moderation_case"."status" = 'closed' AND "moderation_case"."claimed_by" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."claimed_until" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decision" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."reason" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "moderation_case"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_case"."closure_kind" IN ('abandoned','erased'))

moderation_case_decision_check.name: moderation_case_decision_check
moderation_case_decision_check.value: "moderation_case"."decision" IS NULL OR ("moderation_case"."kind" = 'verification' AND "moderation_case"."decision" IN ('approve','reject')) OR ("moderation_case"."kind" IN ('log','filer_update') AND "moderation_case"."decision" IN ('approve','ask_changes','reject')) OR ("moderation_case"."kind" = 'correction' AND "moderation_case"."decision" IN ('uphold','ask_changes','correct','withdraw'))

privacy_request_due_check.name: privacy_request_due_check
privacy_request_due_check.value: julianday("privacy_request"."due_at") IS NOT NULL AND "privacy_request"."due_at">="privacy_request"."received_at" AND ("privacy_request"."kind"!='closure' OR julianday("privacy_request"."due_at")<=julianday("privacy_request"."received_at")+30)

retention_hold_time_check.name: retention_hold_time_check
retention_hold_time_check.value: julianday("retention_hold"."placed_at") IS NOT NULL AND julianday("retention_hold"."review_due_at") IS NOT NULL AND julianday("retention_hold"."expires_at") IS NOT NULL AND "retention_hold"."placed_at"<="retention_hold"."review_due_at" AND "retention_hold"."review_due_at"<="retention_hold"."expires_at" AND ("retention_hold"."released_at" IS NULL OR (julianday("retention_hold"."released_at") IS NOT NULL AND "retention_hold"."released_at">="retention_hold"."placed_at"))

verification_case_inspection_check.name: verification_case_inspection_check
verification_case_inspection_check.value: ("verification_case"."reviewer_id" IS NULL AND "verification_case"."id_kind" IS NULL AND "verification_case"."result" IS NULL AND "verification_case"."name_match" IS NULL AND "verification_case"."inspected_at" IS NULL) OR ("verification_case"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_case"."id_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_case"."result" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_case"."name_match" IS NOT NULL AND typeof("verification_case"."name_match") = 'integer' AND "verification_case"."name_match" IN (0,1) AND "verification_case"."inspected_at" IS NOT NULL)

verification_case_decision_check.name: verification_case_decision_check
verification_case_decision_check.value: ("verification_case"."decision" IS NULL AND "verification_case"."reason" IS NULL AND "verification_case"."decided_at" IS NULL) OR ("verification_case"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_case"."decision" IN ('approve','reject') AND "verification_case"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("verification_case"."reason", char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||' ')) > 0 AND "verification_case"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

verification_case_approval_check.name: verification_case_approval_check
verification_case_approval_check.value: "verification_case"."decision" IS NULL OR "verification_case"."decision" != 'approve' OR ("verification_case"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_case"."result" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_case"."result" = 'pass' AND "verification_case"."name_match" IS NOT NULL AND "verification_case"."name_match" = 1)

verification_case_time_check.name: verification_case_time_check
verification_case_time_check.value: ("verification_case"."inspected_at" IS NULL OR "verification_case"."created_at" <= "verification_case"."inspected_at") AND ("verification_case"."decided_at" IS NULL OR ("verification_case"."created_at" <= "verification_case"."decided_at" AND ("verification_case"."inspected_at" IS NULL OR "verification_case"."inspected_at" <= "verification_case"."decided_at")))
